Welcome To Banana Nextbot! 🍌

In this game, you run around as you are being chased by a Banana image.
You can earn badges from finding hidden Bananas across the map!
This game is inspired by nico's nextbots and gmod.

Please Like and Favorite the Game! 👍⭐
